attr.title: GoldenEye 007
attr.desc: Experimental AArch64/GLES GoldenEye 007 source port for R36S. Supply your own verified US NTSC ROM; first launch generates the required ROM-derived sidecars locally.
attr.inst: Install ge007.zip with PortMaster. Put your own US NTSC GoldenEye 007 ROM at ge007/data/ge007.ntsc-final.z64, then launch once to generate sidecars. No ROM or extracted game data is included.
